description: The Global Hubs aviation table ranks 50 cargo airports by freight and mail tonnes. Dmitry Golubnichiy publishes it as part of a freight-only hub series. CSV and Parquet versions list airport identifiers, city and country, WGS84 coordinates, cargo tonnes, year-over-year change and operator where known. The table is accessible from the repository and a versioned Zenodo concept DOI. Both the folder documentation and Zenodo state CC0, so reuse is free. An aviation modeller could select cargo nodes or compare airport throughput for air-freight capacity and network-disruption scenarios. Each row represents one airport, not a flight, route or time series. The release is dated 2026, but this review did not inspect individual throughput years or original airport reports. Passenger demand and runway or terminal capacities are outside this table. No data payload or row values were downloaded. Related Global Hubs tables cover container ports, inland freight terminals and cargo carriers; these are distinct resources with separate DOIs.
